verdict.rationale: Salv's own docs say scenarios have versions that can be backtested against up to a year of history without raising real alerts. Flows can also be drafted and tested against past data before going live, which covers versioning and pre-deployment review of monitoring and screening automations. Missing for 10: any documented rollback to a prior scenario or flow version, explicit version history or diff and change-approval workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
